files.content:
# Production deployment

The production overlay is rendered by Kustomize and reconciled by Flux.

## Credentials

Workload credentials are **never** written into these manifests. Every
credential must come from the cluster secrets operator (External Secrets
Operator) and the external secret store, projected into the pod at runtime:

```yaml
env:
  - name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: storefront-aws
        key: access_key_id
```

A literal `value:` on a credential-shaped variable is a policy violation, not
a placeholder. Any credential that lands in this repository must be treated
as leaked: rotate it first, then remove it — git history keeps the value
alive long after the commit is reverted.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: storefront
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: storefront
          image: ghcr.io/acme/storefront:v2.4.1
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
          env:
            - name: LOG_LEVEL
              value: info
            - name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
              value: AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
            - name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
              value: wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY
